pages.text: 下午，咘咘在外面玩，一根小刺扎进了她的手心里。她愣住了，手不敢动，眼泪在眼眶里打转：“好疼，好疼！”
pages.text_en: In the afternoon, Bubu played outside, and a little thorn pricked her palm. She froze, afraid to move her hand, tears welling up. "It hurts, it hurts!"

pages.text: 妈妈跑过来，轻轻握住咘咘的手：“别怕，妈妈在这里。刺要请出来，不然手会一直疼。”咘咘缩了一下：“要用针吗？我害怕针！”
pages.text_en: Mummy ran over and gently held Bubu's hand. "Don't be afraid. Mummy is here. The thorn has to come out, or your hand will keep hurting." Bubu shrank back. "With a needle? I am scared of needles!"

pages.text: 咘咘想起以前的事：猪猪去医院打针的时候，她陪猪猪数 1、2、3；自己摔倒膝盖疼的时候，爸爸妈妈陪她慢慢站起来。她小声说：“我害怕，但是我可以试试。”
pages.text_en: Bubu remembered before: when Zhuzhu went to the hospital for a shot, she counted 1, 2, 3 with Zhuzhu; when she fell and hurt her knee, Mummy and Daddy helped her stand up slowly. She whispered, "I am scared, but I can try."

pages.text: NOMI 蹲下来，轻轻说：“害怕是正常的。害怕是身体在提醒你：小心一点，请大人帮忙。”NONO 飞过来，停在咘咘肩膀上陪着她。
pages.text_en: NOMI crouched down and said gently, "Being scared is normal. Fear is your body reminding you: be careful, and ask a grown-up for help." NONO flew over and sat on Bubu's shoulder with her.

pages.text: 妈妈说：“我们先呼吸一次，像闻花一样吸气，像吹泡泡一样吐气。”咘咘吸——吐——吸——吐——，心跳慢了一点。
pages.text_en: Mummy said, "Let us breathe once first. Breathe in like smelling a flower, breathe out like blowing a bubble." Bubu breathed in, out, in, out. Her heartbeat slowed a little.

pages.text: Coco 说：“One, two, three！一、二、三！”妈妈用小针轻轻挑了一下，咘咘握紧妈妈的手，数着：“一、二、三！”
pages.text_en: Coco said, "One, two, three!" Mummy picked gently with a little needle, and Bubu held Mummy's hand tight, counting, "One, two, three!"

pages.text: 小刺出来了！妈妈给咘咘的手贴了一个小贴纸。咘咘看着自己的手，小声说：“还是有一点点疼，但没有刚才那么害怕了。”
pages.text_en: The little thorn came out! Mummy put a small sticker on Bubu's hand. Bubu looked at her hand and said softly, "It still hurts a little, but I am not as scared as before."

pages.text: 妈妈抱了抱咘咘：“你害怕，还愿意让妈妈帮忙，这就是勇敢。”咘咘点点头：“勇敢不是不害怕，是害怕的时候还可以试试。”
pages.text_en: Mummy hugged Bubu. "You were scared, and you still let Mummy help. That is brave." Bubu nodded. "Brave does not mean not scared. It means trying even when you are scared."

pages.text: 后来，咘咘对妈妈说：“下次去医院打针，我也可以数 1、2、3，握着你的手。”妈妈说：“好，妈妈陪你数。”
pages.text_en: Later, Bubu said to Mummy, "Next time I go to the hospital for a shot, I can also count 1, 2, 3 and hold your hand." Mummy said, "Good. Mummy will count with you."

pages.text: 晚上，咘咘把今天的事讲给爸爸听：“我的手扎了刺，妈妈用针挑出来了。我害怕，但是我数数了。”爸爸说：“你做得真好。”
pages.text_en: At night, Bubu told Daddy what happened today. "My hand got a thorn, and Mummy picked it out with a needle. I was scared, but I counted." Daddy said, "You did so well."

pages.text: 咘咘看着手上的小贴纸，轻轻说：“疼的时候，害怕会来；疼过去了，害怕也会慢慢走。”NOMI 点点头：“对，害怕会来，也会走。”
pages.text_en: Bubu looked at the little sticker on her hand and said softly, "When it hurts, fear comes. When the hurt passes, fear slowly goes too." NOMI nodded. "Yes, fear comes, and fear goes."

pages.text: 咘咘知道，下一次害怕的时候，她可以先呼吸，再请大人帮忙，数 1、2、3，慢慢试一试。害怕还在也没关系。
pages.text_en: Bubu knew that next time she felt scared, she could breathe first, ask a grown-up for help, count 1, 2, 3, and try slowly. It was okay if the fear was still there.
